verdict.rationale: Instinct's own docs never describe bulk or batch operations. The only support is hands-on tester reports of multi-item work: testers praised it for "cleaning up inboxes" and one user cites CRM management and growing podcast-booking follow-ups. That suggests the agent can act across many items, but only glancingly. The settings tool that deletes all indexed external data is a data-control feature, not a user-directed bulk operation, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of bulk/batch actions, evidence of the scale or reliability of multi-item operations, and detail on how users specify, preview or confirm bulk changes.
